emphasis_points: Highlight purposeful workspace utility: broad desktop surface for laptops, monitors, notebooks, and task lighting.
Describe integrated storage configurations (hutch shelving, pull-out keyboard trays, stationary drawers, cable pass-through grommets) based on specifications.
Emphasize ergonomic knee clearance, sturdy leg frameworks that eliminate wobbling during typing, and durable desktop lamination or solid wood finish.
avoid_list: Do not claim water-proof or heat-proof engineered wood surfaces without verified source coatings.
Do not invent cable management ports, privacy modesty panels, or drawer locks not explicitly stated.
Do not make exaggerated claims regarding academic or career success; ground descriptions in ergonomic focus and organization.
tone_notes: Focused, disciplined, and purposeful, promoting mental clarity, organized productivity, and dependable physical stability.
